info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Loyalty Loyalty Balances-v1-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Balances Retrieval API provides access to the current loyalty balance information for customers. This endpoint allows businesses to query and retrieve detailed loyalty balance data, enabling seamless integration with customer relationship management systems or frontend applications. Typical consumers include developers building client applications for retail or hospitality sectors where loyalty programs are prominent. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance customer engagement and provide real-time updates on loyalty rewards.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve their current loyalty balance. It provides information on the total points accumulated, points redeemed, and any points that may be expiring soon. This is essential for users to track their loyalty rewards and make informed decisions about redeeming their points.
